[LEXP.5.7.3] **`cosine` is this composition, and no other.** For
vectors $a$ and $b$, each sum taken left to right over the components in
argument order and every operation rounded once ([LDET.3.6.1]):

$$\operatorname{cosine}(a, b) = 1 - \frac{a \cdot b}{\sqrt{a \cdot a} \times \sqrt{b \cdot b}}$$

The two norms are taken separately and then multiplied. The result is IEEE
754's at every operand ([LDET.3.6.2]): when either vector is zero the quotient
is `0.0 / 0.0`, and the result is NaN, which [LEXP.4.2] keeps out of working
memory.
